metadata.description: Contributions, aid cases and monthly reports for the Ehsas Program welfare fund of Megowal village.

landing.about: Ehsas Program is a welfare fund run by the people of Megowal village. Members give a fixed amount every month, and the fund helps families in need with weddings, funerals, medical treatment, school fees and other needs. Every rupee is recorded openly.
landing.loginNote: Members and heads log in with their mobile number.

transparent.title: Open accounts
transparent.body: Every month's report shows the total collected, the total spent and the balance.

aid.title: Help tracked to the end
aid.body: Every aid case is followed from request to completion, and families' names stay private.

members.title: Check anytime
members.body: Members can see their contributions, pending months and reports on their phone.

login.subtitle: Enter your mobile number and password.

memberCases.privacy: Families' names are kept private to protect their dignity. A name is shown only when the family has agreed.

disbursements.receivedByHint: Who took the money: the family, a shopkeeper, the hospital…

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.subtitle: Program costs not tied to a case · {month}: {amount}
expenses.addHint: Stationery, printing, transport and other running costs.

transfers.addHint: Move money between the fund's own accounts, for example cash deposited into the bank.

accounts.subtitle: Where the fund's money is kept

rates.addHint: The rate applies from the chosen month until a newer rate starts.

rates.notePlaceholder: For example: agreed in the October meeting

fund.title: Fund rules
fund.subtitle: Emergency reserve, second-head approval and privacy
fund.reserveHint: Kept aside for sudden needs like a death in a family. It is not counted as free money on the dashboard or in the month closing.
fund.enabled: Ask a second head to approve large payments
fund.enabledHint: Payments above the limit wait until another head (not the one who entered it) or the admin approves them.
fund.limitHint: Payments above this amount need approval.
fund.namesDefault: Show beneficiary names to members on new cases
fund.namesDefaultHint: Only the starting position of the switch on the new case form. Each case can still be changed, and existing cases are not affected.

backup.title: Full backup
backup.body: Download every record (members, payments, bills, cases, aid, expenses, accounts, closings and the activity log) as one Excel file, one sheet per collection.
backup.hint: Keep the file somewhere safe and give the heads a copy. Passwords are not included. Each download is recorded in the activity log.

setup.title: Opening setup
setup.subtitle: Move the paper register into the app

stepHints.dates: Months before the first month stay on paper. From the first month on, everything is kept in the app.
stepHints.balances: Write what each account held at the start of the first month, as the register shows.
stepHints.members: For each member: when they joined, and what they still owed before the first month.
stepHints.imports: Optional: add members, old payments and old completed cases from Excel files.
stepHints.summary: Compare these totals with the register before closing the first month.

setup.locked: {month} is closed, so the opening setup is now read-only. The admin can reopen the month to change it.
setup.lockedShort: The first month is closed; old records can no longer be imported.
setup.dashboardBody: Enter the first month, account balances and members' old dues from the paper register.

dates.programStartHint: The day the fund started on paper.
dates.firstMonthHint: Bills, payments and closings start from this month.

balances.noAccounts: Add an account first (for example, cash in hand).
balances.hint: Once the first month is closed, these can no longer change.

members.noneHint: Add members, or import them from Excel in the Import step.
members.paidSince: {amount} already paid off it in the app
members.someFailed: {saved} saved, {failed} could not be saved. See the red rows.

imports.needFirstMonth: Set the first month in step 1 before importing old records.
imports.membersHint: New members from an Excel sheet. Members already in the app are skipped.
imports.historyHint: Payments written in the register before the first month. They show in each member's ledger as from the register and do not change any balance.
imports.casesHint: Cases completed before the first month, with the total paid. They do not change any balance.

summary.compare: Check each total against the paper register. If something differs, fix it in the earlier steps before closing the first month.
summary.duesHint: {count} members owed something before the first month.
summary.duesPaid: Paid off since in the app
summary.registerHint: History only; these never change a balance.

summary.markDoneBody: You can still change it until the first month is closed.

install.iosBody: Add Ehsas to your home screen in two steps:
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari.
install.iosStep2: Choose “Add to Home Screen”, then Add.
